entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I need to return an item. Order number 8-6-7-5-3-0-9.

Certainly. Let me just pull that up for you... Okay, I see the order here for the Aero Road Helmet. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's just not what I wanted. The color is off. The box is unopened. I just need a return label, not a 20-minute conversation.
I completely understand you're busy. I just need to confirm the delivery date... I see it was delivered 38 days ago. Let me just check our policy for that specific helmet.
Look, is this going to be a problem or not?

No problem at all. My system shows that this item is eligible for return up to 90 days after delivery. Since you're well within that timeframe, I can approve this for you right now. We want to make sure you're happy with your gear and your safety.
I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email address on file. You can print that out, attach it to the shipping box, and drop it off. Once we receive the helmet, we'll issue a full refund.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
